label.title: Brute Force Login Protection
label.description: Protect your Jahia server from brute-force login attacks by automatically banning IP addresses after a configurable number of failed login attempts.

general.title: Global settings
general.whitelistIpsInvalid: Whitelist contains invalid CIDR entries. Expected format: a.b.c.d/n or ipv6/n.
general.ignorePatternsHint: Regular expressions applied to log lines / failure messages. Matching events are ignored, mirroring fail2ban's ignoreregex.
general.trustProxyHeaderHint: Enable only when Jahia is behind a trusted reverse proxy; otherwise attackers can rotate the header to evade detection.
general.recidiveFactorHint: Multiplier applied to subsequent ban durations for repeat offenders (must be ≥ 1.0).
general.recidiveFactorInvalid: Recidive factor must be a number greater than or equal to 1.0.
general.maxBanTimeSecondsHint: Hard cap on ban duration including recidive escalation (must be > 0).
general.maxBanTimeSecondsInvalid: Maximum ban time must be a positive integer.
general.auditLogMaxEntriesHint: Oldest entries are evicted once this limit is reached.

jails.title: Jails
jails.description: A jail groups a failure source with detection thresholds. Add or tune jails to match different protection scopes.
jails.name: Name
jails.nameHint: Unique identifier; cannot be changed after creation.
jails.confirmDelete: Delete jail "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

bans.title: Banned IPs
bans.description: IPs that are currently banned across the cluster, sorted by most recent ban.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Recent security events recorded by the protection service.
audit.confirmClear: Clear the entire audit log? This cannot be undone.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.emailRecipientHint: Address that receives ban notifications. Notifications are throttled per-IP to avoid mail floods.
integrations.webhookUrlHint: HTTPS endpoint invoked on ban events. Leave blank to disable.
integrations.webhookSecretHint: Used as the HMAC signing key for outgoing webhook payloads. Leave blank to keep the current secret.
integrations.webhookSecretConfigured: A webhook secret is currently configured.

flush.title: Flush everything
flush.description: Clears all bans, failure counters, and tracked windows cluster-wide. Audit log entries remain.
flush.confirm: This clears all bans and counters cluster-wide. Continue?
flush.error: An error occurred while flushing state.
